Organizing rule: each functionality is built up in TWO steps -- a MINIMAL prototype commit (smallest real slice) with its test, then a COMPLETION commit (the rest) with its test. Some commits are single (atomic removals, docs, one build tweak). Your spec entry has a "slice" field: minimal | completion | single.

WORKSPACE
- Work ONLY in worktree /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim (branch review/andesim-series). NEVER modify /home/nick/work/andesim's main checkout or other worktrees; read-only git against /home/nick/work/andesim is fine ('git -C /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim show <sha>' reaches all history).
- NEVER 'git push'. Only branch review/andesim-series.
- Start: 'git -C /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim status --short' clean (config.env + build outputs allowed untracked). End: EXACTLY ONE new commit, clean status.

SPEC

Historical commits are reference only; the final file is the fixed form.

SLICE SEMANTICS (critical -- this makes the series reviewable)
- slice=minimal: code genuinely does ONLY the small slice, and its test checks ONLY that slice. E.g. "Andes CSR drain+verify, min (mxstatus)" drains + verifies ONLY mxstatus (hand-coded, not the X-macro loop); "runtime crt0/UART, min" only makes vplat_hello print, no exit/file-io yet; "fixtures, min (one C fixture)" relinks ONE fixture. You author a genuinely reduced version, NOT the final file.
- slice=completion: expand the prior minimal slice to full final form and extend the test to cover all. After it, the touched file matches final MINUS still-later-feature parts.
- slice=single: author to final form minus later-feature parts, per construct. Removal commits ('refactor!: remove ...') delete the named subsystem.
- The construct field says exactly what reduced/full content to write and how to derive it from the final file.

INCLUDE/ SUBMODULE: at the ABI-pin commit (spec functionality abi-submodule, ~c010) replace the in-tree include/hybrid headers with the andesim_abi submodule using include_submodule_recipe: 'git rm -r' the in-tree headers, remove leftover include/, 'git -C /home/nick/work/andesim/include worktree add --detach /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim/include <v2 sha>', 'git -C /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim add include' + the .gitmodules entry (copy from final tree). To advance the pin later (v3/v4/v5/v6 commits): 'git -C /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim/include checkout <sha>' then 'git -C /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim add include'. Never make include/ a plain tracked dir after that.

BUILD-ORDER FACTS: ABI structs/macros exist only after their pin (hybrid_andes_csr after v3 ~c050, hybrid_m_ext_csr after v4 ~c054, hybrid_l2c after v5 ~c072, write_mask.h after v6 ~c074). Do not reference a not-yet-pinned symbol. The real external vsim first interoperates at the v6 pin (~c074/c075) -- a real e2e smoke is EXPECTED to fail before then (record, do not gate); it must PASS from the write-mask commit on. NEVER introduce a legacy_never_add item.

VALIDATION ENV: export QEMU_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/qemu_andesim/build/qemu VSIM_BIN_DIR=/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=/home/nick/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d and PATH as needed. /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim/config.env already exists.
- Run every validate item in your spec entry from /tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/669779f8-77ed-406b-ab12-a36a1624de65/scratchpad/wt/andesim. Cheap standing checks once pieces exist: 'make -C qemu_plugin', the driver build + unit-test subset (see scripts/test_all.sh), 'make -C runtime', 'make -C tests/fixtures'. 'EXPECTED TO FAIL' notes mean record, don't gate.
- If validation cannot pass, DO NOT commit broken: fix it or return status=blocked with detail.

COMMIT MESSAGE: first line = spec subject verbatim. Blank line. Body = 2-6 full sentences from body_points (what + why; note the minimal/completion step so a reviewer sees the build-up). End with exactly:
